solver_compatibility.reason: C++ v4 supports zero-skew 50% duty with opposite-phase feedback and certified opening-response hold bounds.

semantics: Edges contain only the reported combinational Q-to-D/port delay, excluding latch arcs and IO budgets. Phase windows are relative to cycle start. Feedback event/cycle mapping must be defined by the solver adapter; no uniform per-edge cycle shift is assumed.
limitations: Only the present 18-cell counter and supplied OpenSTA text layout are supported.
Topology and rise/fall pair coverage are checked; report truncation or omitted reconvergent alternatives can still affect extrema.
Scalar cell envelopes are fixed-condition report values, not multi-PVT characterization.
Pulse requirements are copied from reports; unreported checks are not claimed absent from Liberty.
This is a schema-v4 interchange, not executable v3 solver input.
